title: Runes Smp Mod
description: This mod adds custom weapons with special abilities. Each weapon will require the highest tier possible of a weapon/tool/arpor piece, 4 trims of a specific type, and 1-4 items/blocks.
body:
This mod adds 4 weapons to minecraft.

The Techno Scythe: a Scythe that has high damage, give strength, speed, saturation, fire risistance.

Light Saber: Shoots Fire Ball, sets hit targets on fire, extends reach, boosts movement speed.

The Dune Spear: has a chance to give slowness and blindness to hit targets.

The Staff Of Ender right click to summon enchanted bottles.
